prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one new production identity painting for The Apprentice's Notebook: Wessel, the Unregistered. A grumpy exiled guild student. Bare head with a low tied tail at the nape, drafting apron with a clearly visible pale irregular rubbed-out patch, and a long broad rolled-paper tube on the back at a confident diagonal. Tube upper end visible outboard of the head and over the shoulder, with a clearly projecting angle; upper tube end starts beside the head to stay visible in close crops. Tube lower end also projects out to the opposite side. Graphite-blue working cloth, one small indigo apron tie. Stance slightly turned and chin tucked.
Image 1 shows the three APPROVED neighboring characters, an ensemble reference only for body proportions, camera, finish and scale. Invent this identity according to the subject description. Output one person only. Image 2 is a clean crop for matte paint and lighting. Image 3 is the palette strip: district dark/mid/light #28323A #768890 #D5D7CC; then the small clothing accent #4A3F94; then the city night colors #1F2A3A #3A4148 #5D666D #A9BCC6. Hold these swatches' color saturation in the major masses and keep warm colored lamplight over cool cloth. Match the style, proportions and finish of the attached approved anchors.
Composition: one standing complete head-to-boots sprite cutout at the largest available native portrait dimensions (2:3 if possible). High 3/4 tactics camera, from slightly above, facing screen right like the references. Foreshorten tops of head and boots. Fit both boots fully in-frame, centered and planted with the feet close to the bottom-center baseline, leaving narrow transparent margins all around. When fitted on the 128×176 game canvas the body reads at about 1.3 cells. Real RGBA transparency around every edge and between limbs and props. There is no ground, no backdrop or visible checkerboard, no contact shadow, no baked shadow, and no side rim light. Sparse engraved edge marks with clean outer contour and fine paint grain, simplified forms. Silhouette key that must survive at 24 px in greyscale: Unequivocal diagonal drafting tube, narrow bare skull with a low tied tail, long uneven apron with pale blank patch.
No glyphs, seals with symbols, pseudo-lettering, insignia, flags, border, ground, shadow or matte fringe. Do not use any reference character as the output. Painted 2D game art, broad matte gouache-like value masses, fine paint grain, sparse engraved ink detail at material edges. Light from the upper left. Warm lamp light against cold blue night; wet surfaces catch small highlights. Soft distant detail. No text, no letters, no numbers, no UI, no frames, no arrows, no grid lines, no reach dots, no health bars, no targeting rings, no watermark.
